quests.title: The French Revolution Time Machine
quests.description: Travel back to revolutionary France and witness how ordinary people changed the course of history!

story.introduction: Professor Revolution has activated the time machine! Experience the French Revolution firsthand and understand how ideas of liberty, equality, and fraternity spread across the world!

steps.title: Causes of Revolution Investigation
steps.narrative: Investigate pre-revolutionary France! Discover the social, economic, and political problems that led to the revolution.

problem.question: What was the main cause of the French Revolution?
problem.explanation: Revolutionary analysis! The Third Estate (common people) paid all taxes while nobles and clergy paid none. This inequality plus financial crisis sparked revolution!

steps.title: Estates General Assembly
steps.narrative: Attend the historic Estates General meeting! Understand how the three estates represented different social classes in French society.

problem.question: Which estate represented the common people in France?
problem.explanation: Political mastery! The Third Estate included everyone who wasn't clergy or nobility - farmers, merchants, lawyers, and workers. They were 98% of the population!

steps.title: Declaration of Rights Workshop
steps.narrative: Help draft the Declaration of the Rights of Man and Citizen! These revolutionary ideas about human rights spread worldwide.

problem.question: What revolutionary idea did the Declaration of Rights introduce?
options: All men are born free and equal
problem.correct_answer: All men are born free and equal
problem.explanation: Revolutionary rights mastery! This declaration stated that all people are born with natural rights to liberty, equality, and fraternity - ideas that changed the world!

steps.title: Napoleon Legacy Challenge
steps.narrative: The ultimate revolutionary test! Understand how Napoleon both continued and changed the revolutionary ideals across Europe!

problem.question: How did Napoleon spread revolutionary ideas across Europe?
options: By conquering territories and implementing reforms
problem.correct_answer: By conquering territories and implementing reforms
problem.explanation: Revolutionary legacy mastered! Napoleon's conquests spread the Civil Code, abolished feudalism, and introduced revolutionary ideas across Europe, changing the continent forever!

quests.title: The Democracy Builder Academy
quests.description: Learn to build strong democratic institutions and become a champion of democratic values!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Democracy Builder Academy! Principal Democracy needs your help to design the perfect democratic system that ensures justice, equality, and freedom for all citizens!

steps.title: Constitution Design Workshop
steps.narrative: Design a constitution that protects everyone's rights! Learn why constitutions are the foundation of democratic societies.

problem.question: What is the most important feature of a democratic constitution?
options: It should protect fundamental rights of all citizens
It should favor the majority only
It should be written in difficult language
problem.correct_answer: It should protect fundamental rights of all citizens
problem.explanation: Constitutional mastery! A democratic constitution must protect everyone's fundamental rights, ensuring that even minorities are safe from majority tyranny!

steps.title: Electoral System Laboratory
steps.narrative: Design fair electoral systems! Learn how different voting methods can affect representation and democratic outcomes.

problem.question: What makes an election truly democratic?
options: Free, fair, and regular elections with universal suffrage
problem.correct_answer: Free, fair, and regular elections with universal suffrage
problem.explanation: Electoral excellence! Democratic elections must be free (no coercion), fair (equal opportunity), regular (periodic), and include all adult citizens (universal suffrage)!

steps.title: Separation of Powers Fortress
steps.narrative: Build a fortress of democracy using separation of powers! Learn why dividing government power prevents tyranny.

problem.question: Why is separation of powers important in democracy?
options: To prevent any one branch from becoming too powerful
problem.correct_answer: To prevent any one branch from becoming too powerful
problem.explanation: Democratic fortress secured! Separation of powers (legislative, executive, judicial) ensures checks and balances, preventing dictatorship and protecting democracy!

steps.title: Become a Democratic Values Guardian
steps.narrative: The ultimate democracy test! The Democratic Values Guardian challenges you to defend democratic principles against all threats!

problem.question: A majority wants to pass a law that discriminates against a minority group. In a true democracy, what should happen?
options: The constitution should protect minority rights
problem.correct_answer: The constitution should protect minority rights
problem.explanation: Democratic Values Guardian achieved! True democracy protects minority rights even against majority wishes. This is constitutional democracy - rule of law, not just majority rule!

quests.title: The Economic Systems Academy
quests.description: Explore different economic systems and understand how societies organize production and distribution!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Economic Systems Academy! Professor Economy will teach you how different societies solve the fundamental economic problems of what to produce, how to produce, and for whom to produce!

steps.title: Economic Problems Laboratory
steps.narrative: Every society faces basic economic problems! Professor Economy shows you how different systems try to solve these challenges.

problem.question: What is the fundamental economic problem that all societies face?
problem.explanation: Economic wisdom! Scarcity is the basic problem - people have unlimited wants but resources are limited. This forces societies to make choices!

steps.title: Market System Simulation
steps.narrative: Run a market economy simulation! See how supply, demand, and prices work together to allocate resources.

problem.question: In a market economy, what determines the price of goods?
problem.explanation: Market mastery! When demand is high and supply is low, prices rise. When supply is high and demand is low, prices fall. The market finds balance!

steps.title: Poverty and Development Mission
steps.narrative: Tackle the challenge of poverty and development! Understand how economic growth can improve people's lives.

problem.question: What is the best indicator of a country's development?
problem.explanation: Development understanding! True development means people live longer (health), learn more (education), and have better living standards (income). It's about human welfare!

steps.title: Economic Policy Advisor Challenge
steps.narrative: The ultimate economic test! Advise the government on economic policies that will improve people's lives while maintaining economic stability!

problem.question: A country has high unemployment. What economic policy would be most effective?
options: Invest in job training and infrastructure
problem.correct_answer: Invest in job training and infrastructure
problem.explanation: Economic Policy Advisor mastery! Investing in skills training and infrastructure creates jobs, improves productivity, and leads to sustainable economic growth!
